source_evidence: Framework master commit 3b09a303867416edf7eca3232fe69b0a6e83fb92 carries actual block-comment context through source/reader.py and shared_source.py; missing local bodies cannot borrow a separately annotated neighbor.

packages/match-recovery/tests/source/test_roundtrip.py and tests/test_shared_functions.py cover prose braces, quoted delimiters, unterminated blocks, header-homed bodies, shared comment blocks, and same-line close/reopen boundaries; independent review found no remaining blocker.

recovery/tests/test_wave_device_exports.py now supplies the actual create_device/delete_device/release bodies directly from match_recovery.source record.region to the VC6 lifecycle harness; the temporary anchor-extraction workaround is removed.
This resolves the extraction defect only. It does not accept the retained C++ migration or resolve the separate Sound-chain ownership and lifetime findings.
